verdict.rationale: Calendly's own Workflows feature automates pre- and post-meeting emails and texts in response to meeting events (calendly-docs-12), and routing forms apply basic rule logic to qualify invitees before booking (calendly-docs-11). The documented actions are limited to communications, and the rule-definition model is described only in a single line. Webhooks (calendly-docs-62, calendly-docs-54) are developer building blocks for custom automation, not built-in rules, so they add no credit. Missing for 10: documented trigger/condition configuration for Workflows, actions beyond emails/texts, AI-native rule authoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.
